title: Bank statement to general ledger reconciliation for the last closed month
prompt: Reconcile each bank statement to the general ledger for the last closed month. Match transactions and explain every outstanding difference.

setup.q: Which bank accounts are reconciled every month?
Below what amount is an unexplained difference recorded as a note rather than an exception?

inputs.name: Bank statements, one per account in scope

steps: resolve the bank accounts in scope and the period dates; read the period-lock state and any reconciliation Dime already holds for the month
for each account get the statement: the Plaid connection first, then statements uploaded to Dime, then a document request per account
pull the single-account general ledger for each bank account for the period
match statement lines to ledger rows one to one by date and amount, then by reference; a statement line never matches two ledger rows
list every unmatched item on each side: deposits in transit, outstanding checks, bank-only items (fees, interest, returned items), book-only items; age each one

tie each account: statement ending balance plus deposits in transit less outstanding checks equals the ledger ending balance; a residual above the threshold is an exception, below it a note, never a plug
propose the bank reconciliation record per account with the matched items and the outstanding list (tier A); never finalize it
write the workbook with one Tie-out block per account

done.text: For each bank account in scope the reconciled book balance on the Tie-out equals the ending balance of that account in Dime's general ledger at the period end
Every exception row cites the statement line or the ledger transaction id and the bank account
bank-reconciliations.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words

Every outstanding difference is explained one by one as a deposit in transit, an outstanding check, a bank-only item or a timing item; nothing is netted or plugged, and the reconciliation is proposed for a person to finalize, never finalized by the desk

tierRules.when: create the reconciliation record for one account and period with the matched items and the outstanding items listed
finalize or lock a reconciliation (never proposed; a person finalizes in Dime)
